result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY definition of the Architecture Lock 'Local signed journal' integrity invariant for Offline Private Reality. Current G4 journal is append-only JSON with SHA-256 entity hashes but has no HMAC/keyed seal, no previous-entry chain seal, no key-provider boundary, and no explicit offline_private_reality consumer gate. R1 (persist) is sole product writer for seal/key/consumer-gate implementation. Local seal is reconciliation evidence only — NOT Shared District or server authority.

in_scope: HMAC-SHA256 (or equivalent keyed chain) integrity seal over canonical journal entry material
Previous-entry seal/hash linkage + sequence index + world_revision in seal material
Injected/local key-provider boundary (device-local; never production key hardcode)
Fail-closed integrity conditions (wrong key, modified/removed/reordered entry, broken prev seal, invalid seal)
Explicit offline_private_reality consumer gate for journal apply
G3 rejected handoff must not auto-journal as committed
API surface additions for R1 persist
out_of_scope: Product implementation under game/scripts/modules/persist/** (R1 sole writer)
game/scripts/main/main.gd mount wiring (R2 core sole writer)
Executor product edits (R3 VERIFY_ONLY consumer tests only)
Server World Commit, economy, inventory, marketplace ownership
Database, API SDK, credential upload, dependency install
Treating local seal as online/shared world truth

signed_journal_integrity.statement: Every durable journal entry carries an HMAC-SHA256 integrity seal over canonical seal material that includes the entry payload (without seal), previous entry seal (or genesis), world_revision after apply, and sequence index. Load/replay verifies the full chain fail-closed. Key material is obtained only through an injected/local key-provider boundary.
signed_journal_integrity.architecture_lock_alignment: Local signed journal for Offline Private Reality only; reconcile on sync later uses offline_journal_reconcile — seal is local evidence, not server commit.

forbidden: production keys hardcoded in source, fixtures, or exports

recommended_api.content_hash_still_used: entity_hash / entity_set_hash remain unkeyed SHA-256 over aidle_canonical_json_v1 (P0 INV-HASH-STABLE preserved)
recommended_api.note: Entity content hashes and entry integrity seals are distinct: content hash = deterministic world state equality; seal = tamper-evident journal lineage under local key

algorithm.name: HMAC-SHA256
algorithm.equivalent_allowed: Keyed chain Hi = HMAC-SHA256(key, prev_seal || canonical_entry_i_material) is the required shape; pure unkeyed SHA-256 chain alone is NOT sufficient for Architecture Lock 'signed'

seal_material.name: aidle_journal_seal_material_v1
seal_material.description: Canonical JSON object hashed under HMAC. Built from entry fields EXCLUDING the seal field itself (and excluding any runtime-only noise).

required_fields_in_material.schema_version: const 1.0.0 of journal envelope (or seal_schema_version if R1 versions seal independently; default bind journal schema_version)
required_fields_in_material.sequence_index: integer — 0-based append index of this entry (must equal array index in entries[])
required_fields_in_material.prev_seal: lowercase hex seal of previous entry; for sequence_index=0 use genesis_prev_seal
required_fields_in_material.world_revision: integer — entry.new_world_revision (head AFTER this entry applies)
required_fields_in_material.operation_or_compensation_fields: For mutation_applied: operation + entity_ids (sorted) + entity_delta canonical; for compensation: prior_receipt_id + prior_request_id + compensated_entity_ids (sorted) + entity_delta + history_erased=false
required_fields_in_material.entry_payload_hash: OPTIONAL but recommended: sha256_hex(aidle_canonical_json_v1(entry_without_seals)) to bind full entry bytes tightly

genesis_prev_seal.rule: For sequence_index=0, prev_seal MUST be HMAC-SHA256(key, utf8(aidle_canonical_json_v1(genesis_material))) OR a documented constant derived from key+journal genesis.
genesis_prev_seal.note: Empty string prev_seal is forbidden. Genesis must still be key-dependent so wrong key fails the first entry.

seal_material.canonicalization: aidle_canonical_json_v1 (P0): sorted keys, compact UTF-8, fixed float rules. Seal message bytes = UTF-8 of canonical_stringify(seal_material_object).
excluded_from_seal_material: API keys, tokens, credentials (forbidden in journal entirely)
updated_at envelope churn that is not part of the entry
runtime node paths / preview mesh ids

required_on_each_entry_after_r1.prev_seal: 64 hex — previous entry seal or genesis

integrity.head_seal: seal of last entry (or genesis if empty)
integrity.key_provider_id: string id of provider class/mode (e.g. test_key_provider | device_local_provider) — NEVER the key bytes

backward_compat_load.unsigned_legacy_journals: Journals lacking seal fields are integrity-invalid for correction acceptance. R1 MAY refuse load with error_code journal_integrity_unsigned OR support a one-time migrate-under-key path that re-seals only when explicitly invoked with a key provider and never silently treats unsigned as verified.
backward_compat_load.default_for_g4_correction: Fail closed: unsigned entries => journal_integrity_invalid on verify_integrity / load when integrity enforcement is enabled (default ON after key provider set).

chain_rules: Recompute seal on load; constant-time hex compare recommended; any mismatch fail closed
world_revision progression and request_id uniqueness rules from P0 remain mandatory in addition to seals

key_provider_boundary.statement: Integrity keys are obtained only through an injected or device-local key-provider interface. Production keys are never hardcoded. Smoke uses a clearly marked deterministic TEST key.

provider_interface_shape.name: IJournalKeyProvider (logical; may be RefCounted callback or methods on PersistModule)

methods.name: get_journal_hmac_key
methods.notes: Called by journal_store only when sealing or verifying; key must not be logged, journaled, exported to smoke evidence as secret, or written to commits

injection_rules: PersistModule.set_key_provider(provider) is the sole injection point for production and smoke
If no key provider is set: create/apply/save of sealed journals must fail closed with error_code key_provider_missing (do not seal with empty key; do not silently disable integrity)
Key bytes never appear in journal JSON, entity hashes, logs at info level, or exports/* evidence files
Key is not an API credential, Nakama token, Desktop Bridge secret, or server auth material
Device-local provider may derive from OS-secure storage later; G4 correction MVP may inject bytes via test provider only

test_key.marker_required: provider_id must contain 'test' (e.g. test_key_provider) AND smoke evidence must set integrity.test_key=true
test_key.deterministic_bytes_recommendation: UTF-8 of a fixed labeled string such as 'AIDLE_G4_JOURNAL_HMAC_TEST_KEY_V1' padded/hashed to 32 bytes via SHA-256 — never used outside smoke/tests
test_key.forbidden: Shipping builds must not default to the test key; production path requires non-test provider_id

key_provider_boundary.wrong_key_behavior: Loading or verify_integrity with a different key than the sealing key MUST fail closed (journal_integrity_invalid / journal_integrity_wrong_key). Do not partial-load entities.

fail_closed_integrity_cases.trigger: verify or load with key provider that does not match sealing key
fail_closed_integrity_cases.behavior: Refuse load/verify; error_code journal_integrity_wrong_key or journal_integrity_invalid; no entity set materialization from untrusted chain

fail_closed_integrity_cases.trigger: Any sealed field of an entry (payload, revision, ids, entity_delta, etc.) altered after seal
fail_closed_integrity_cases.behavior: Recomputed seal mismatch => fail closed journal_integrity_invalid; do not skip entry

fail_closed_integrity_cases.trigger: Middle or tail entry deleted from entries[] while later seals/count remain or head_seal stale
fail_closed_integrity_cases.behavior: sequence_index / prev_seal / entry_count / head_seal chain break => fail closed. Removing last entry without updating envelope also fails head integrity.
prev_seal chain and sequence_index fail => journal_integrity_invalid
Fail closed immediately at first break; do not continue best-effort replay

fail_closed_integrity_cases.trigger: Missing seal, wrong length/charset, seal_alg != hmac-sha256, or HMAC mismatch

fail_closed_integrity_cases.behavior: Fail closed (default for correction acceptance); optional explicit re-seal tool is separate and must be intentional

consumer_gate.statement: Only explicit offline_private_reality confirmed operations may append to the local signed journal. G3 rejected World Commit handoff must not auto-journal as committed. Online Private Reality, Shared District, economy and ownership mutations must be rejected or routed to server World Commit — never local journal.

confirmation.rule: confirmation.state must be confirmed when confirmation object present (P0 preserved); unconfirmed preview never journals

space_type.rule: Must be private_reality; shared_district always rejected (P0 AT-SPACE-BOUNDARY preserved and strengthened at request gate)

g3_rejected_handoff_rule.rule: A consumer MUST NOT call apply_mutation/apply_compensation solely because a G3 complete handoff stub exists. Journaling requires an explicit offline_private_reality apply with confirmed authority metadata. world_commit_invoked=false AND durable_mutation_applied=false means NOT committed; local journal entry is a separate explicit Offline Private Reality simulation action, never an implicit promotion of the stub.
g3_rejected_handoff_rule.test_requirement: R3 executor VERIFY_ONLY must prove rejected G3 path does not produce mutation_applied; R1 smoke must reject requests that only wrap the stub without offline authority gate fields

reject_matrix.result: rejected; route to server World Commit (not implemented here)

reject_matrix.input: authority.context in server_economy|ownership|marketplace OR mutation claims currency/inventory authority
request carries world_commit_invoked=false durable_mutation_applied=false without explicit offline_private_reality confirmed apply

recommended_entry_api.name: apply_offline_private_reality_mutation
recommended_entry_api.purpose: Single consumer-facing gate that validates authority metadata then delegates to sealed apply_mutation
recommended_entry_api.notes: apply_mutation may remain internal/low-level but must enforce the same gate when called; public consumer path should be the explicit offline method

preserved_p0_invariants.note: R1 MUST preserve all P0 behavioral invariants; integrity is additive fail-closed, not a replacement

invariants.statement: Entries append-only; compensation links prior_receipt_id; no rewrite/delete of history
request_id idempotency; duplicate => idempotent_replay; no second entity/revision bump
expected_world_revision must match head or revision_mismatch with zero partial mutation
entity_hash / entity_set_hash SHA-256 over aidle_canonical_json_v1; save/reload equality
Canonical JSON sorted keys + fixed float format
Cancelled previews / unconfirmed manifestation never durable
G3 starter expected_world_revision/base 3 preserved; default 0 must not win
Local journal apply is Offline Private Reality simulation durability only
No API keys/tokens/credentials in journal, saves, hash or seal material

local_seal_authority_clarification.statement: A valid local HMAC seal proves only that journal bytes were produced/extended under the device-local key provider for Offline Private Reality reconciliation evidence. It does NOT authorize Shared District placement, server economy, multiplayer ownership, or stand in for world_commit_service.

status_semantics.local_status_committed: Means mutation_applied or compensation entry sealed and appended to local journal successfully
status_semantics.not_equal_to: commit_receipt issued by world_commit_service with server authority

local_seal_authority_clarification.reconcile_future: On sync, offline entries may be proposed for server reconciliation under mutation_class=offline_reconcile / authority.source=offline_journal_reconcile; server remains durable authority for online/shared contexts (ARCHITECTURE_LOCK).
